 short by Bhawana Chaudhary / 05:22 pm on Tuesday, 27 October, 2026 Actress Navika Kotia, known for 'English Vinglish' and 'Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai', has ended her engagement with businessman Mazen Mody. After meeting through an arrange marriage setup, they got engaged in January. As per TOI, they were planning to get married next year but parted ways due to compatibility issues. Mazen has now confirmed he's dating actress Ritika Badiani. read more at Hindustan Times Inshorts Pte. Ltd.
